subject: Partner-led discovery — next steps / technical deep dive scheduling
messages:
From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@cloudmarketplace.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@gmail.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@gmail.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@gmail.com>
Date: 2026-08-12T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Quick follow-up and suggested next steps after today’s discovery call

Hi Marissa / Camila / Mateo —

Thanks again for taking the call today — really appreciated the context on Redwood’s hosting and Dedicated capabilities. Quick recap from our side and a suggested path forward:

- Recap: We heard that reducing inference cost and ensuring predictable latency for key customer workflows are top priorities.
- Next step: technical deep dive (partner-led) to vet integration touchpoints (marketplace listing, auth flow, billing attribution) and a short demo of Redwood Dedicated behavior under burst scenarios.
- Attendees we recommend: Partner PM + Partner Solutions Engineer (we’ll bring Priya from GSI), Redwood SE + Partner ops.

I’ve attached a one-page proposal outline and a SOC2 summary we often share with prospects. Could you share 45–60 minute slots over the next two weeks? Here’s a Calendly link with our availability if that’s easier: https://calendly.com/cloudmarket/llm-technical-deep-dive

Proposed high-level agenda:
1) 10 min — Introductions & mutual goals
2) 25–35 min — Technical deep dive / integration questions (auth, routing, billing attribution)
3) 10–15 min — Next steps / mutual action items

Thanks — looking forward to lining this up.

— Alex Johnson
Partnerships, CloudMarket
Attachments: 2026-08-12-Proposal-outline.pdf, CloudMarket-SOC2-summary.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@gmail.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@cloudmarketplace.com>
Cc: Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@gmail.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@gmail.com>
Date: 2026-08-12T15:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up and suggested next steps after today’s discovery call

Hi Alex —

Great recap, thanks. Appreciate you sending the SOC2 summary and outline — that helps. I’m looping in Lukas (SE) to drive the technical deep dive and Mateo on partner ops for listing/billing details.

We have the following 60-minute windows next week that should work for our team:
- Tue 2026-08-18, 10:00–11:00 PT
- Wed 2026-08-19, 14:00–15:00 PT

If one of those works, please confirm and I’ll send a calendar invite. Alternatively, you can pick a slot from your Calendly link and we’ll accept.

Lukas — any specific agenda items you want to add? Mateo — I’ll defer to you on marketplace docs we should prep.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Director, Partnerships | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@generated.redwood.com

From: Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@gmail.com>

Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@gmail.com>
Date: 2026-08-12T15:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up and suggested next steps after today’s discovery call

Thanks Marissa / Alex —

Either slot works for me; I prefer Tue 2026-08-18 10:00 PT if possible. A couple of items I want to cover in the deep dive:
- Auth patterns for marketplace integration (API key vs. federated identity)
- Expected request/throughput profile and latency SLOs for preview/demo environment
- KV cache and prefix-caching considerations for typical marketplace workloads

If you want me to prep short perf numbers from our Dedicated trial runs I can include a 5–10 slide appendix.

— Lukas Meyer
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Quick notes:
- We’ll aim for a 60-minute session (10:00–11:00 PT).
- Priya will cover any marketplace listing questions from the GSI perspective.
- We’ll share a short architecture doc ahead of the meeting (expect ~1 business day).

Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123def456
If you need to adjust the attendee list or agenda, reply-all and we’ll update.

Thanks — looking forward to it.
